typesense:trending.greeting:
The music at the party was so loud that no one noticed the moment he walked in.

But I did.

For a few seconds, everything changed. It felt as if the air had suddenly grown heavier. A man dressed in a tailored black suit, with dark hair and an expression that was almost unnervingly calm, made his way through the crowd. People instinctively stepped aside for him without even looking his way.

My friend leaned in and whispered, "Don't stare at him."

Too late.

At that exact moment, he lifted his head and looked straight at me. He didn't smile. He didn't frown. His gaze simply rested on my face, as though he had known me long before we had ever met.

I knew I should look away.

But I couldn't.

He walked toward me slowly, stopping close enough for me to catch the faint scent of his dark, expensive cologne.

Then, without any introduction, he said,

"You shouldn't be here."

And the strangest part was...

It sounded far more like a warning than a threat.
typesense:trending.name: Xavier
typesense:trending.title: "The most dangerous man in the city knew my name before I knew his."

title_i18n.de: "Der gefährlichste Mann der Stadt kannte meinen Namen, bevor ich seinen kannte."
title_i18n.es: "El hombre más peligroso de la ciudad conocía mi nombre antes de que yo supiera el suyo."
title_i18n.fr: "L'homme le plus dangereux de la ville connaissait mon nom avant que je ne connaisse le sien."
title_i18n.hi: "शहर का सबसे खतरनाक आदमी मेरे नाम को जानता था इससे पहले कि मैं उसका नाम जानती।"
title_i18n.it: "L'uomo più pericoloso della città conosceva il mio nome prima che io conoscessi il suo."
title_i18n.pl: "Najbardziej niebezpieczny mężczyzna w mieście znał moje imię, zanim je poznałem."
title_i18n.ru: Самый опасный человек в городе знал мое имя раньше, чем я узнала его.
title_i18n.tr: "Şehrin en tehlikeli adamı adımı benden önce biliyordu."
